messages.content: I need details for interface with fabric Network4, node 5

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve all queues on a specified interface for a given node and fabric name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to.

params.description: Query parameters to specify the scope of the GET request.

siteGroupName.description: Name of the Site Group to limit records to sites within this group. Example: 'GroupA'.

siteName.description: Name of the Site to limit records to this specific site. Example: 'Site123'.

nodeName.description: Name of the node to limit records to this specific fabric node. Example: 'Node1'.

interfaceName.description: Name of the interface to limit records to this specific node interface. Example: 'eth0'.

ip.description: The IP address of the target server in IPv4 format, such as '192.168.1.1'.

message.content: Could you let me know which specific interface on node 5 you’re interested in? Also, if there’s a particular site or site group you’d like to limit the query to, please share that information.
message.reasoning: The user wants details for interface with fabric Network4, node 5. They didn't specify interface name. We need to call the function requests_get with appropriate params. The function signature: requests_get({url: string, params: {siteGroupName?, siteName?, nodeName?, interfaceName?, ip?}}). We need to provide url endpoint. The description says "retrieve all queues on a specified interface for a given node and fabric name." So we need to supply nodeName and interfaceName. But they didn't give interfaceName. Maybe we can ask for clarification. But the instruction says "If you do not have enough information to answer the question, ask clarifying questions." So we should ask clarifying question: which interface? Also maybe need siteGroupName or siteName? They didn't provide. So we ask clarifying question.
